title: Uncovering Bias in Large Vision-Language Models at Scale with Counterfactuals
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating intersectional bias along the dimensions of race, gender, and physical characteristics. While its lexical analysis of stereotypes identifies terms with religious and moral connotations (e.g., 'mosque', 'imam', 'hindu', 'terrorist') associated with specific ethnic groups, religion and ethics are not the primary categories of investigation or the benchmarked attributes of the study.
